title: Configure firstmate as the first study instance in athena.toml
summary: Set athena.toml's [capabilities.study] repo_url to https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate and repo_ref to main, replacing the commented example. The M1 work-handling study runs as a separate study job afterward, because it reads this config from the base commit.

defaults_applied.how: Recovered the target keys from the commented example in athena.toml.
Verifier runs cargo test, clippy and fmt --check.
Only a public repo URL is added.

assumptions: This job only edits the configuration; the M1 study is a separate study job run afterward.
The repo_url form is the plain https GitHub URL without .git.
Editing athena.toml is permitted because the request names it as the deliverable.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml [capabilities.study] has uncommented repo_url = "https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate" and repo_ref = "main"; the example placeholder lines are gone.
A short comment notes this is the first study instance and that Athena pins the ref to a commit before dispatch.
No other key in athena.toml changes, and no other file changes except optionally a CHANGELOG.md line.
Run `cargo test --locked` and `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`: both pass.

out_of_scope: Running the M1 work-handling study itself
Copying any firstmate content into this repository
Changing study commands, env, or checks
departures: Tiny single-file config change, so cost and time are lower and pass odds higher than the reference.
